comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Tides generator, vendored unchanged at eurorack/tides; src/aestus.cpp is the Rack wrapper. The Sheep wavetable firmware is a model inside the same module rather than a separate one, chosen by the MODEL knob, and the mode button and CLOCK input change meaning with it. The FREQUENCY knob's default tuning is shifted by a volt: aestus.cpp:179 adds calibrationOffsets[1], which is -1.0, to the pitch input so that a centred knob gives C4; the Compatibility options menu restores the older tuning by selecting the 0.0 entry instead. Clock sync engages on a patched cable rather than on a held button as the hardware does, and aestus.cpp:154 ANDs that cable test with the model, so the Sheep model ignores it and needs the SYNC button. The peacocks plotter at aestus.cpp:278 bypasses the generator entirely and drives only UNI and BI.
